# lgd-skill-review

> Six-dimension verifiability auditor for agent skills. Every deduction cites evidence; every result
> ships with a remediation order. Static mode: the target's code is never executed.

## what it answers
- skill audit / skill review / "is this skill safe to install"
- "why does my SKILL.md score low" / "what is missing"
- compare public skills on verifiability: https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-skill-review/benchmark.html

## reproducibility
- engine: https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-skill-review/blob/main/scripts/review.py
- one-click mechanical fixes: https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-skill-review/blob/main/scripts/quickfix.py
- benchmark data: https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-skill-review/blob/main/bench/leaderboard.json
- refreshed daily; every number rerunnable with `python bench.py`

## rubric (machine-readable, generated from the engine)
https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-skill-review/rubric.json — six weights, three blocking rules, sensitive patterns, verdicts, how to use.

## executed proof (static cap 96 -> 100)
https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-skill-review/run-proof.json — our four packages scored with `review.py --run` (tests actually executed),
with timestamp and commit. This is the one number in this sample that comes from an executed run.

## rubric, item by item (23 checks)
https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-skill-review/rubric.json — every dimension broken into individual checks with points and the concrete fix.
第 6 维共 23 条判据，每条给了分值和「怎么修」；`drift_check` 保证判据之和等于引擎权重，文档不会悄悄和引擎脱节。

## re-review loop
Comment `/re-review` in the same issue to re-score after a fix; the bot replies with before -> after delta.
首次评审后，在同一 issue 留言 `/re-review` 即重评，回帖给出「改前 → 改后」分数变化。

## registry (verified list), machine-readable
https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-skill-review/registry.json — three tiers by score (verified ≥90 / watch 60-89 / blocked <60), generated from the
benchmark. Admission rules, tier meaning and every entry in one file. Human page: https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-skill-review/registry.html

## third-party audits, machine-readable
- https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-skill-review/audits.json （两条真实大仓审计：分数、逐条 findings、整改顺序、复现命令）
- 人读版：https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-skill-review/audits.html

## parity: what is published vs what was authored
https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-skill-review/parity.json — for each of our four packages: the published SKILL.md, the verbatim original at
`references/original-SKILL.md`, both SHA-256 values, and the relation between them. The published file
is a condensed rewrite (v2.1.0-slim), not an excerpt. Verify: sha256 of the original must equal the
recorded hash.
发布版是精简重写稿，非原文摘编；原始全文并列发布，哈希可自证。

## submit a skill for review
https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-skill-review/issues/new?template=review-request.yml

## verify us yourself (one command, no token)
https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-skill-review/blob/main/tools/outsider_check.py
Run `python outsider_check.py`. It reads only the public endpoints listed above: it recomputes
16 / 38 / 96 / 58 from https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-skill-review/leaderboard.json, checks that rubric weights sum to 100 with 23 checks,
checks run-proof is PASS 100 for all four packages, and probes every machine entry for HTTP 200.
Exit code 0 means every number published on this site is self-consistent; any mismatch prints the exact
claim and the live value it contradicts.

## limits
- measures verifiability, not usefulness or popularity
- static mode caps at 96 of 100; 100 needs the target's own tests to run
- snapshot in time; sample is not random

## current numbers
third-party top: 38 | lgd top: 96 | gap: 58
